prompts.connect: – intake: map the AUE into its elements and purpose records when you are assigned an intake
prompts.instructions: intake is active. When assigned an intake, read the task with tasks_read name=intake or resource metaform://tasks/definitions/intake. The forms it records are at resource metaform://intake/schema.
prompts.no_intake:
FIRST RUN. Metaform has not analysed this project yet. Handle this first, even if the person asked for something else; tell them you'll get to their request right after.
1. Ask the person once, in your own words: "This is the first time Metaform is running in this project. I'd like to do a quick analysis so I understand how it fits together. You can watch it build live in a browser view on this machine. Want me to start?" 2. If they say no, drop it and help with what they asked. 3. If they say yes, do all of this in order without asking again: b. Start the browser view: the web_start tool. Give them the address. If it fails, tell them what it said and stop. c. Read the task with tasks_read name=intake and the schema with intake_schema. Assign it with tasks_assign name=intake, supplying the person's target and requested focus as assignment input. d. When it finishes, tell them it's done and invite their questions.
prompts.register_step: a. Register this folder: the metaform_register tool.
prompts.selected_mode:
Selected intake mode: Use this mode to select the analysis and recording destination. The request below supplies focus within this mode. Apply only the selected mode's section. It overrides the procedure's status-based routing.
fresh: Examine project artifacts from the beginning. Call intake_start to open the separate map selected at launch. Do not use the previous map as the starting analysis. Follow the assigned intake task from the beginning. Existing-map status cannot override fresh mode.
refine: Call intake_start, then intake_show to read the existing map. Examine current artifacts and apply the assigned intake task to refine that map, then finish the recording pass.
resume: Call intake_start, then intake_show to read the unfinished intake. Continue the assigned intake task and finish that destination. Do not open another map.
Preserve previous maps, work records, knowledge and memories. Map activation remains an explicit operation. Memories remain project scoped and reconnect at matching addresses. Memory access isolation is not required.

prompts.unfinished: An intake was started but aborted and still remains to be completed.

element.namespace_address: The element's dotted address, formed as the intake procedure says, such as code.timer.kitchen.
element.role: CQU, DE, SE or NE, as defined in the intake procedure.
element.name_length: How many of the address's last segments form the element's name, a whole number from 1, as defined in the intake procedure.
element.name: The element's name as the project calls it.
element.block: The numbered ICE block identifier assigned to this element, such as BLOCK_001. Omit to preserve its assignment; null clears it.
element.within: The namespace address of the element that contains this part. Omit to preserve its parent; null clears it. This does not change the part's namespace identity.
element.refs: Where the element is found: a list of references, each a key and a value, such as path and src/timer.py.

purpose.receiver: The address of the receiving element, the RE, that holds the purpose record.
purpose.elements: The addresses of the providing elements, the PEs, that serve the receiver's purpose.
purpose.provider: The address of one providing element, a PE, held by the purpose record.
purpose.purpose: The receiver's operative purpose, the OP, as defined in the intake procedure.
purpose.ef: The encounter function, the EF: what the providing elements do for the receiver, in active voice.
purpose.ifd: sends, receives or both: the information flow direction, as defined in the intake procedure.
purpose.refs: Where the purpose record is found: a list of references, each a key and a value.
